name: A Thousand Cuts
requirement: You are holding a weapon with the Agile trait
description:
You move faster than what should be possible, cutting into an enemy.
Make a melee Strike with an agile weapon.
If you hit, you may attack again at a -2 penalty, or -1 if you attack with an agile weapon in your other hand
You may keep attacking until you miss, with the multi attack penalty increasing as described above every time

name: Absorb Magic
trigger: You would take elemental damage
description:
Use your magical connection to absorb the elemental energy.
Reduce the damage by 2d6

name: Aim
requirement: You are holding a ranged weapon
description:
You carefully aim your next ranged attack, gaining a +2 bonus to the attack roll. 
Additionally, you ignore the obscured condition on the attack if the target is obscured.
The bonus lasts until you move or the start of your next turn.

name: Aura Block
trigger: When you would partially block damage with your aura.
description:
Block the force of the attack with your Aura, making it take all of the damage. 
If it breaks your aura, you take the remaining damage.

name: Avert Eyes
trigger: At the start of your turn
description:
You avert your eyes from one or more creatures, avoiding effects that would trigger on eye contact.
You cannot be affected on eye contact with them until the start of your next turn.
You take a -5 penalty on any saving throws they impose on you.
They gain a +5 bonus on saves you impose on them, and you cannot make targeted attacks against their head.
If they are Huge this bonus is reduced to +3, and if they are Gargantuan it becomes +1.

name: Battlefield Medicine
requirement: You are holding a medicine kit
description:
Make a Mend Wounds check.
Creatures can only have their health restored by Battlefield Medicine once per day

name: Battlefield Stomp
description:
Every creature within 3 tiles must make a basic Fortitude save against your golems attack.
On a failure they take 2d6 bludgeoning damage and fall prone.

name: Blade Dance
description:
You move gracefully like a dancer in the flow of combat
Strike, then Step, then Strike another creature

name: Block
requirement: You are holding a weapon with the Block trait
description:
Get ready to block incoming attacks and spells. 
You have a +X bonus to your Reflex and Fortitude saves against targeted attacks and non-environmental area effects until the start of next turn.

name: Block Spell
trigger: A creature is targeting you and at least one ally, who you providing cover to and you used Block last turn
description:
You position your shield in front of the blast. Make your save with a -4 penalty.
If you succeed the allies you a providing cover to automatically succeed their save

name: Burrow
description:
Move a number of tiles up to your burrow speed.
By default, you can only burrow through loose material.

name: Calculate The Odds
description:
Declare an action that requires a D20 roll and roll a d20. 
If your next action afterwards is to do that action, use that roll
You may use this a number of times equal to your INT per day

name: Cast a Spell
description:
Make a spellshaping check (Int + Dex + Proficiency) against the difficulty of the spell. On a success, the spell is cast.
The result of the spellshaping check is used for the DC of any saving throws imposed by the spell.

name: Cat Fall
trigger: When you would take fall damage
description:
Make an Acrobatics check, and reduce the fall damage by that much
If you take no damage from it you may Step as a free action.

name: Charge
description:
You rush forward, attacking your opponent with your momentum.
Stride twice, then make a melee Strike.

name: Coil Up
description:
Coil your lower body up to move in a burst of speed.
Next turn you may Step or Stride once as a free action. 
If you move or are knocked prone, this bonus is lost

name: Combat Assessment
trigger: You hit an enemy with a melee strike
description:
As you strike an enemy you quickly assess its capabilities. 
Make a Recall Knowledge check against the creature.

name: Combat Regeneration
description:
Use one of Regeneration charges.
You cannot use this if you took fire, lightning or acid damage since your last turn

name: Crash of the Titan
trigger: You are holding a melee weapon that does bludgeoning damage
description:
Your weapon slams into the ground, creating a shockwave from the impact
Strike a tile within range, all creatures on and adjacent from it must make a basic Reflex save against the attack.
Creatures on the slammed tile take an additional 2d10 bludgeoning damage. 
This damage bonus is doubled if you were falling or jumping as you did the attack

name: Crawl
description: Move one tile.

name: Cut Down Projectile
trigger: You are parrying and are forced to make Reflex save against a projectile
description:
Attempt to cut down the projectile. 
Make a melee attack against it, instead of a Reflex saving throw

name: Cut Down Spell
trigger: You are parrying and are forced to make Reflex save against a spell
description:
You've learned to cut down spells just like projectiles. 
Make a melee attack against it, instead of a Reflex saving throw

name: Deadshot
requirement: You are holding a weapon with the Ranged trait
description:
You take a moment to focus and take a perfectly aimed shot.
Make a ranged strike, dealing an additional weapon dice on a hit.

name: Defensive Positions
description:
You order your allies to take cover.
Up to three allies can use their reactions to Step or Traverse into Cover or use an action with the Defensive trait

name: Double Shot
requirement: You are holding a weapon in the Bow weapon group
description:
You draw two arrows at once and loose them at separate targets.
Make two attacks on two different targets in range.
You have a -2 penalty on both attacks, but your multiple attack penalty increases first after both shots.

name: Double Slice
requirement: You are wielding two melee weapons, one in each hand.
description:
Make two weapon attacks at the same target, one with each weapon.
If the second weapon is agile, it takes no multiple attack penalty; otherwise the penalty is -2.
If both attacks hit you combine their damage for the purpose of overcoming resistances.

name: Dragonbreath
description:
Breathe out a 3 tile cone of elemental force.
Make a Fortitude save; creatures inside the cone must make a basic Reflex save against your result.
Failure: They take 3d6 damage.

name: Draw Mana Thread
description:
Touch a creature and draw a thread of mana to it.
If the creature is unwilling, it may make a Reflex save against your Channeling roll.
Success: You connect an invisible mana thread to it.
While the thread is up you can cast spells on the creature as if you were adjacent to it, and you know its exact position.
The thread consumes 1 mana per turn and breaks if:
The target moves 6 or more tiles away, it gains full cover, or you break it as a free action.
Creatures with Truesight or passive Manasense higher than your roll can sense the thread.
Creatures aware of it may spend an action and mana equal to your WIL to break it.

name: Drink Potion
requirement: You are holding a potion or have one on a potion belt
description: Gain the benefits of the potion.

name: Drop
description: You become prone.

name: Drums of War
description:
Make a warchant to hype yourself and your allies up for battle.
You and allies within 5 tiles gain temporary hit points equal to your WIL plus half your level, which last up to a minute.

name: Duck
trigger: You are forced to make a Reflex saving throw
requirement: You have a land move speed of 2 or more
description:
You attempt to dive out of the effect, moving 1 tile.
If this causes you to leave the area of the effect, you get a +5 bonus to the saving throw; otherwise it's a +3 bonus.
After making the save you fall prone.

name: Duelist's Defense
trigger: You hit a creature with a Strike or Spell
requirement: You are holding a weapon with the Light trait that is not the weapon you made the Strike with
description: Block or Parry with the Light weapon

name: Elemental Aura
description:
Infuse your aura with an aspect, giving it resistance 5 to damage of that aspect and a bonus based on the chosen aspect.
While you have your Elemental Aura up, you can force any creature that ends its turn next to you to make a Reflex or Fortitude save against a WIL check.
On they fail, you deal 2d6 damage to them.
You can sustain your Elemental Aura as an action for 3 mana, as if it were a spell.
You can also drop it as a reaction or free action on your turn.

name: Escape
description:
Attempt to free yourself from being Grappled or Restrained.
Make a Brawling or Acrobatics check against the Brawling roll of the creature grappling you.
Success: You become Grappled instead of Restrained, or free if you were already Grappled.
Critical Success: You immediately become free.

name: Expand Aura
description:
Expand your aura an amount of tiles equal to your WIL away from you.
Any attacks that hit or pass through that space automatically hit your aura, blocking half the damage.
You may Aura Block as normal, absorbing the entire attack.
Keeping your aura expanded costs 5 mana per turn.

name: Extend Aura
trigger: A friendly creatures within 3 tiles takes damage
description:
Expand your aura to cover the creature.
Your aura takes half the damage they would take.

name: Fan The Hammer
description:
Make a ranged Strike against a target within your runegun's first range increment. 
Keep attacking until you have made four attacks or your Magazine runs out.

name: Far Shot
description:
You make a shot beyond the normal range of the weapon.
Make a ranged strike at two range increments above the default at no penalty.

name: Feed Potion
requirement: You are holding a potion or have one on a potion belt
description: Feed a willing adjacent creature a potion, giving them its benefits

name: Feint
description:
You make a maneuver that appears as a strike to throw an enemy off-guard.
Make a Deception check against the Perception roll of an enemy within melee strike range.
Success: The creature becomes off-guard 2 for the rest of the turn.
Critical Success: The creature becomes off-guard 2 until the end of its next turn.

name: Fire Capacitor
description:
The golem projects a 5 tile cone of fire.
Every creature in the cone must make a basic Reflex save, taking 4d6 fire damage on a failure.
After use, you must then recharge the capacitor with 5 mana as an action while adjacent to your golem.

name: Flood Aura
description:
You flood your aura with mana to quickly reinforce it, even at the risk of losing some.
Specify the amount of mana you wish to reinforce, then make a Channeling skill check against a DC of that amount.
Critical Success: You reinforce your Aura with the chosen mana.
Success: You reinforce your Aura with two-thirds of the chosen mana, losing the rest.
Failure: You reinforce your Aura with half of the chosen mana, losing the rest.
Critical Failure: You lose all of the mana you specified.

name: Flurry of Blows
description:
Make three unarmed Strikes.
Each strike counts towards your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty increases first after all three.

name: Fly
description:
Move a number of tiles up to your fly speed.
Flying one tile upwards costs two movement; the opposite is true for downwards.
If you are airborne at the end of your turn and didn't use a Fly action this round, you fall.

name: Flying Kick
description:
Leap, then make an unarmed Strike at any point during the leap.
It deals an additional 1d6 damage.

name: Frost Capacitor
description:
The golem projects a 4 tile cone of freezing air.
Every creature in the cone must make a basic Fortitude save, taking 3d4 cold damage on a failure.
Medium and smaller creatures that fail the save also become Frozen 1, or Frozen 2 on a critical failure.
After use, you must then recharge the capacitor with 5 mana as an action while adjacent to your golem.

name: Glide
description:
Move a number of tiles up to your glide speed.
You cannot glide upwards, and you fall one tile downwards per four tiles you fly forwards (minimum one per round).

name: Grapple
requirement: You have one hand free
description:
Make a Brawling check against the Brawling roll of a creature within your reach.
The creature may defend with a Reflex or Fortitude save instead, taking a -2 penalty to the roll.
Success: You Grapple the creature.
Critical Success: It also becomes Restrained.
You can only have one creature Grappled at a time, and you cannot Grapple a creature two or more sizes larger than you.
Successfully grappling an already Grappled creature Restrains them.

name: Guarded Advance
description:
Move protected towards your opponent.
Take an action with the Defensive trait, then Stride twice.
You must end your movement closer to an enemy than you were when you started.

name: Guide Cast
requirement: You are holding a weapon with the Aiming Focus trait
description: If your next action is to cast a spell with the Targeting trait, you cast it at double the range.

name: Harness Mana
description:
Attempt to absorb mana from the air.
Make a Mana Sensing or Channeling roll against a DC based on the environment.
Critical Success: You recover double the specified amount of mana.
Success: You recover the specified amount of mana.
Critical Failure: You suffer one level of mana poisoning.
If you spend two actions on this action, you get a +2 bonus on the roll and recover twice the amount.
If you spend three actions, the bonus increases to +5.

name: High Jump
description:
Jump up to 2 tiles vertically.
You may attempt an Athletics check to jump higher. The DC is 18 for 3 tiles and increases by 8 for each additional tile.

name: Hold By Thread
trigger: A creature attached by a mana thread attempts to leave its range
description:
Make a WIL roll against the creature's Athletics roll.
If the creature is moving via spell, use their Spellshaping roll instead.
If they are moving in another way, use a fitting roll.
If you roll higher, you hold them and prevent the movement.

name: Identify Spell
trigger: You see a spell being cast
description:
Make an Arcana check against the spell's unmodified spellshaping DC.
Critical Success: You gain a +2 bonus to saves against the spell.

name: Incanter's Stance
description:
Enter a stance of intense magical focus.
While in this stance, when you cast spells with a verbal component, your INT or WIL counts twice.
You also have advantage on Channeling and Mana Sensing checks.
However, you are off-guard 2 and have disadvantage on perception checks.

name: Inspect Soul
description:
Target one creature you can see within 6 tiles. Looking at a creature's soul, you perceive a few details about it. You learn if it has:
An attunement, and if so which aspect.
A soulbond. You can make a DC 20 Arcana check to try to figure out the nature of the soulbond.
Whether any other soul magic is affecting the target, though you don't know what type it is.
If the creature is an illusion, or an object or golem made to look like a creature, you get no information about it, but you can see that it is not a creature.

name: Inspire Courage
description:
You give a rousing speech or perform an act that inspires your allies in a 5 tile wide aura.
All allies in the aura gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and saving throws against fear effects for the duration.
This bonus increases to +2 at level 10 and +3 at level 15. The aura lasts for one minute or until you are incapacitated.

name: Ínstant Strike
trigger: At the start of your turn
description:
You make an attack so quickly that it almost seems like it took no time at all.
Make a melee Strike

name: Intimidate
description:
With threatening words or gestures, attempt to frighten a foe.
Make an Intimidation check against their Will save.
Success: They are Frightened 1.
Critical Success: They are Frightened 2.

name: Leap
description:
Jump up to 3 tiles horizontally.
You may attempt an Athletics check to jump farther. The DC is 15 for 4 tiles and increases by 5 for each additional tile.

name: Lightning Capacitor
description:
The golem projects a 10 tile line of lightning.
Every creature in the line must make a basic Reflex save, taking 3d8 lightning damage on a failure.
Creatures wearing metal armor get a -3 penalty to this save.
After use, you must then recharge the capacitor with 5 mana as an action while adjacent to your golem.

name: Line Ender Shot
description:
With mighty force you fire or throw a projectile, causing it to hit all foes in a line.
Make a ranged strike, against all creatures in a 1 tile wide line along your weapons first and second range increments.
Creatures hit need to make a basic Reflex saving throw, taking 1d10 + normal weapon damage damage.

name: Lunge
description:
Attack an enemy at the edge of your reach. 
Make a melee Strike with a 1 tile bonus range.

name: Measured Strike
description:
You strike with measured practice.
Make a Strike with half your current multiple attack penalty (rounded down).

name: Mend Wounds
requirement: You are holding a medicine kit
description:
Make a DC 10 Medicine check on a target.
Success: You restore 1d6 + 2 health to the creature and reduce its wounded value by 1.
Critical Success: You restore twice the amount and reduce wounded by 2.

name: Momentum Roll
trigger: You would fall prone
description:
You use the momentum of the effect that would knock you down to roll forward and kip up.
Make an Acrobatics check against the effect that would knock you prone.
Success: You Step once and don't fall prone.
Critical Success: You also gain a +2 bonus on Reflex saves until the start of your next turn.

name: Momentum Toss
trigger: A creature misses you with melee attack
description:
Make a Brawling check against the creature's Brawling roll.
It may defend with a Reflex or Fortitude save instead, taking a -2 penalty to the roll.
If they got a critical failure on their attack, they have a -5 penalty on the roll.
Success: You move the creature to another free tile adjacent to you, and it gets a -3 penalty on hitting you for the rest of the turn.
Critical Success: The creature also falls prone.

name: Moonlight Crescent
description:
You make a strike that seems to extend your weapon beyond its normal reach, cutting into multiple foes.
Make a Strike against up to five adjacent enemies in range of your melee weapon with a 1 tile bonus range.
They make their own Reflex saving throw against the attack. 
Creatures hit take an extra 1d8 damage.

name: Open Dimensional Net
requirement: You are sustaining the Dimensional Net spell
description:
Open the net at a point you can see within 5 tiles and set a direction.
The projectiles fly forward from the point in your chosen direction.
If a projectile had a set target, you may select a new one.

name: Parry
requirement: You are holding a weapon with the Parry trait
description:
Get ready to parry.
Until the start of your next turn, when you are attacked by a melee attack, you may defend with your weapon attack bonus instead of your Reflex save.

name: Piercing Thrust
requirement: You are holding a weapon in the Spear or Polearm weapon group
description:
You strike through a creature to hit both it and a creature behind.
Make a Strike against two creatures in a line within reach of your weapon.
This counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty.

name: Pincer Movement
description:
You know how to outmaneuver your enemies.
Choose two allies; they can use their reactions to Step, Stride or Traverse next to an enemy.
If they end their movement on opposite sides of an enemy, one of them can make a Strike against that enemy.

name: Pinning Shot
description:
You shoot or throw your weapon in a way that pins an enemy to the ground or wall.
Make a Strike against a creature.
Success: The creature takes no damage, but is immobilized and off-guard 2 until they spend an action to make a DC 10 Athletics or Acrobatics check.
Critical Success: The DC is 15.

name: Pommel Strike
requirement: You are wielding a weapon in the Polearm or Spear group and you last action was to make a Strike with it
description:
Make an attack with the back end of your weapon using the momentum of your last strike.
Make a Strike with the same multiple attack penalty as your last attack.
On a hit it does 1d4 bludgeoning damage, or 1d6 if you hold the weapon in both hands.
If your weapon has the unwieldy trait, this strike ignores that.

name: Predict Their Movement
description:
Attempt to predict a foe's next move.
Make a Tactics Lore roll against the Tactics Lore or Deception of a creature you can see within 10 tiles.
Success: You learn the next action the creature is planning to take next turn.
It can either choose to do that or take a -2 penalty to all actions next turn as it scrambles to adapt.

name: Protect Ally
requirement: You are holding a weapon with the Block trait
description:
Instead of defending yourself, you get ready to protect your ally.
Give an adjacent creature a defense bonus equal to the Block value of your weapon.
You cannot Block and Protect Ally at the same time with the same weapon.

name: Quick Draw
description:
You draw a weapon and strike with it in the same motion.
Draw a weapon and Strike with it.

name: Quick Parry
trigger: You are forced to make a Reflex saving throw
description:
You draw your weapon in the blink of an eye and parry an opponent's strike.
You may draw a weapon with the Parry trait from a quick access slot.
Then defend against the attack as if you had parried the turn before.

name: Quip
description:
Make a Persuasion roll against the Will save of a creature you can see within 6 tiles.
Success: The target becomes off-guard 1 until the end of its next turn, as the quip distracts them.
Critical Success: It becomes off-guard 2 instead.
Regardless of the roll, the target is immune to Quip for an hour.

name: Rapid Retreat
description:
You order an ally to flee from danger.
Choose an ally and an enemy; the ally can use their reaction to Stride or Traverse to move away from that enemy.
They move with a +1 move speed bonus, and the chosen enemy has disadvantage on Reactive Strikes from the movement.

name: Reactive Strike
trigger: A creature takes a move action within the reach of your weapon.
description:
You take advantage of a creature moving within your reach.
Make an attack against the creature with a -3 penalty, or -2 if you are wielding an agile weapon.

name: Recall Knowledge
description: Make an Arcana, Crafting, History, Nature, Society or Lore check to find out what you know about a creature, place or organisation.

name: Recharge Golem Capacitor
requirement: You are standing next to your golem
description: Restore mana to your golem's capacitor so it can be fired again.

name: Reinforce Aura
description: Spend mana up to your level + double your WIL, and restore aura health by that amount.

name: Reload
requirement: You are holding a weapon with the reload trait
description: Reload your weapon.

name: Rend
description:
You tear through a creatures armor.
Make a melee strike with a weapon that does slashing damage.
On a hit you deal no damage, but reduce the creatures physical resistance by 1d4.
This lasts for 1 hour or until the creature repairs it with a DC 10 crafting check.

name: Riposte
trigger: You are currently parrying and a creature missed you with a melee Strike
description:
Take advantage of the opening to attack your opponent.
Make a Strike at that creature.

name: Run and Gun
requirement: You are holding a weapon with the Ranged trait
description: Stride, then Stride or Take Cover, then make a ranged Strike.

name: Running Reload
requirement: You are holding a weapon with the reload trait
description:
You move and reload your weapon simultaneously.
Stride with a -2 speed penalty and Reload your weapon.
You can spend a focus point to Stride at full speed.

name: Serpent Stride
description: Step, Stride, Strike and Parry in any order.

name: Set Weapon
description:
Set your weapon ready to strike foes that come into your reach.
Until the start of your next turn, your Reactive Strikes ignore the penalty on the strike.
On a critical hit, you disrupt the creature's movement.

name: Sharpshooters Stance
description:
With an eye on your weapon you enter a stance to hit any target.
While in this stance you may add 1d4 to any ranged weapon attacks and perception checks.
However, while in this stance you are off-guard 2.
The stance ends if you move or would be moved against your will.

name: Shield Bash
requirement: You are holding a shield
description:
Hit a foe with your shield to stagger them.
Make a Strike with your shield.
On a hit they become off-guard 3 until the start of your next turn.

name: Shove
requirement: You have one hand free or a weapon with Shove trait
description:
Make a Brawling check against the Brawling roll of a creature within your reach.
The creature may defend with a Reflex or Fortitude save instead, taking a -2 penalty to the roll.
Success: You push the creature up to 1 tile away from you.
Critical Success: The creature is shoved up to 2 tiles instead.

name: Siphon Mana
requirement: Your last action was a failed spellshaping check.
description: Recover half of the spell's mana cost.

name: Slide Into Cover
description:
With a swift move you move and take cover at once.
Stride or Step, then Take Cover.

name: Snap Shot
requirement: You are holding a weapon with the Volley trait
description:
Make a quick shot in the heart of battle.
Make a Strike, ignoring the Volley trait.

name: Sneak
description:
Stride at half speed, remaining in stealth.
If you don't end your turn at a location where you have cover you must make a Stealth check

name: Spellbreak
trigger: You successfully identify a spell being cast within 3 tiles of you.
description:
Spend mana equal to half the spell's cost and make a check against the Spellshaping check of the caster.
If you know the spell being cast, you may add your proficiency in the spell to the roll.
If you got a critical success on the Identify Spell check, you may add your INT or DEX (min 1) to the roll.
If you roll higher than the caster, you prevent the spell from being cast.

name: Spellbreak Strike
description:
You know how to make a strike to disrupt a sustained spell.
Make an unarmed melee strike, or one with a weapon with the channeling trait.
On a hit, make an INT or WIL check against the target's Fortitude save, breaking the sustained spell on a success.
If you know the spell, you may add your proficiency with it to the roll.

name: Spot Weak Point
description:
Make a Medicine check against the Fortitude save of a creature you can see.
Success: You spot a weak spot that you or your allies can attack to deal extra damage to the creature.
This counts as a targeted attack weak point with a reflex bonus of +3.
On a hit the creature takes 1d8 extra damage and becomes stunned 1
The weak spot fades after being hit, and the creature becomes immune to Spot Weak Point for the day

name: Stabilize
requirement: You are holding a medicine kit
description:
Make a Medicine check, DC 10 + the creature's dying value.
Success: The creature reduces its dying by 2.
Critical Success: The creature reduces its dying by 4.

name: Stabilize Spell
trigger: You fail a spellshaping check by your INT or less
description:
Spend the amount you failed by in mana to turn the spell into a success.
The spell's spellshaping DC is still the rolled number.

name: Stand Up
description: You stand up from Prone.

name: Steady by Tail
trigger: You would make a save against being knocked prone, being made off-guard, or being moved against your will.
description: Add your PHY to the roll.

name: Steady Shield
requirement: You are holding a tower shield
description:
Stick a tower shield you are holding in the ground in front of you.
Steadied shields provide greater cover to creatures behind them.
You need to spend an action to recover a steadied tower shield.

name: Steal Attuned Spell
description:
Target a creature maintaining a spell of your attunement within 5 tiles. Spend mana equal to the cost of the spell.
Make a Spellshaping check against the creature's spellshaping check.
Success: You take over the spell, getting the benefits as if you were the caster.
Critical Success: You also recover the mana you spent.
If the spell needs to be sustained, you still need to sustain it in future turns.

name: Step
description:
Move one tile without triggering reactions. 
You cannot Step into difficult terrain.

name: Stride
description: Move a number of tiles up to your land speed.

name: Strike
description:
Make an unarmed or weapon attack, rolling against the target's Reflex save.
Attacks after the first each turn take a stacking multiple attack penalty.

name: Strike Now!
description:
You order an ally to strike at an opportune moment.
Choose an ally; they can use a reaction to make a Strike at a target you both can see.

name: Stunning Strike
description:
Make a forceful strike against an enemy.
On a hit, they must make a Fortitude save or be Stunned 1, or Stunned 2 on a Critical Failure.

name: Sustain
description:
Extend the duration of a spell you are sustaining by 1 turn.
When you sustain a spell, make a spellshaping roll as if you were casting it. You cannot fail the spell when sustaining it, but it's DC changes to the new spellshaping result.
Some spells have effects that happen when you sustain them, such as moving the spell.
You cannot sustain a spell more than once per turn, but you can sustain multiple spells in the same turn by using multiple Sustain actions.

name: Swallow Whole
requirement: The monster has a creature grabbed in its teeth"
description:
Make a Brawling roll against the grabbed creature.
Success: The creature is swallowed and the monster can use its mouth attack again.

name: Sweep
requirement: You are holding a weapon with the Sweep trait
description:
Make a Strike against two adjacent enemies in range of your melee weapon.
They make their own Reflex saving throw against the attack.
This counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty.

name: Swim
description:
Move a number of tiles up to your swim speed.
If you don't have a swim speed, you can make an Athletics check, moving half your land speed on a success.

name: Take Cover
description: You gain cover, or upgrade your cover to Greater Cover.

name: Take Off
description: Fly up to your glide speed.

name: Telekinetic Grab
description:
Pick up and move a light object within 5 tiles.
You may keep it in the air, move it to another spot within range, or move it to you.
If you move it to you and have a free hand, you may catch it.

name: Throw Bomb
requirement: You are holding a bomb or have one on your belt
description:
Throw a bomb 4 + your DEX or PHY tiles. 
The bomb activates and has an effect based on the bomb. 
If the bomb is a gadget crafted by you, you roll Crafting + DEX

name: Throw Device
requirement: You are holding a device or have one on your belt
description:
Throw a device 2 + your DEX or PHY tiles.
The device activates and has an effect based on the device.
If the device is a gadget crafted by you, you roll Crafting + DEX.

name: Trample
description:
The monster Strides up to double its Speed and can move through the spaces of creatures of the listed size, Trampling each creature whose space it enters. 
The monster can attempt to Trample the same creature only once in a single use of Trample. 
The monster deals the damage of the listed Strike, but trampled creatures can attempt a basic Reflex save at the listed DC

name: Transfer Mana
description:
Transfer some of your mana to an adjacent creature. A fast but dangerous way to give a creature mana.
Specify the amount of mana you wish to transfer, then make a Channeling skill check against a DC of twice the amount of mana to transfer.
Critical Success: You transfer the chosen mana.
Success: You transfer the chosen mana, and the target gets one level of mana poisoning.
Failure: You transfer half of the chosen mana, losing the rest, and the target gets one level of mana poisoning.
Critical Failure: You lose all of the chosen mana and the target gets two levels of mana poisoning.
If you spend two actions on this action, you get a +2 bonus on the roll; if you spend three actions, you get a +5 bonus.

name: Trip
requirement: You have one hand free or are holding a weapon with the Trip trait
description:
Make a Brawling check against the Brawling roll of a creature within your reach.
The creature may defend with a Reflex or Fortitude save instead, taking a -2 penalty to the roll.
Success: The creature falls Prone.
Critical Success: The creature also takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

name: Tumble Through
description:
You slide through an opponent.
Make an Acrobatics check against a creature's Reflex save.
Success: You move through their space without provoking reactive strikes.
Critical Success: They also become off-guard 2 to you until the start of your next turn.

name: Whirlwind Strike
description:
You strike all foes around you with your weapon.
Make a melee strike against all creatures within reach.
Creatures that succeed on their save still take half the damage they would take from a normal attack.
You have a -2 penalty this attack and your multiple attack penalty by two steps afterwards.

name: Wild Strike
description:
Strike in a wild swing that leaves you open afterward.
Make a melee Strike and add an additional 1d8 to the damage.
After making this Strike, you become off-guard 2 until the start of your next turn, or prone if you were already off-guard.
